    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Identify the full-width horizontal separator.
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1 and g[r][0] != bg]
    if not line_rows:
        return g
    line_r = line_rows[0]
    line_color = g[line_r][0]
    # All non-background, non-separator cells form the movable figure.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != line_color]
    if not pts:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [[g[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    bh, bw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    # Slide the figure toward and flush against the separator; mark its trailing edge in 8.
    if r1 < line_r:
        nr1 = line_r - 1
        nr0 = nr1 - bh + 1
        trace_r = nr0 - 1
    elif r0 > line_r:
        nr0 = line_r + 1
        nr1 = nr0 + bh - 1
        trace_r = nr1 + 1
    else:
        return g
    for r, c in pts:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for dr in range(bh):
        for dc in range(bw):
            g[nr0 + dr][c0 + dc] = shape[dr][dc]
    if 0 <= trace_r < h:
        g[trace_r] = [8] * w
    return g
